description: M05 Группа 8 (NEW-149) — gRPC client latency по method + error-rate. Источник — grpc.client.duration histogram из GrpcClientMetricsInterceptor. Deadline 3s enforced на stub-level (см. ArchUnit GrpcClientDeadlineTest).

panels.title: gRPC p50 latency (по методу)
panels.description: Existing bounded gRPC client timer by target service/method/status. Histogram quantiles aggregate buckets per caller instance. No normative SLO is implied.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (job, instance, environment, service, method, le) (rate(grpc_client_duration_seconds_bucket{environment=~"$environment",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m])))
